$ kubectl expose deployment nginx --port=80 --name=nginx-svc
--- exit 0
--- stdout
service/nginx-svc exposed
--- stderr

$ kubectl get svc nginx-svc -o wide
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME        TYPE        CLUSTER-IP   EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)   AGE   SELECTOR
nginx-svc   ClusterIP   10.96.0.12   <none>        80/TCP    0s    app=nginx
--- stderr

$ kubectl get endpoints nginx-svc
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME        ENDPOINTS       AGE
nginx-svc   10.244.1.2:80   0s
--- stderr
Warning: v1 Endpoints is deprecated in v1.33+; use discovery.k8s.io/v1 EndpointSlice

$ kubectl describe svc nginx-svc
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Name:                     nginx-svc
Namespace:                default
Labels:                   app=nginx
Annotations:              <none>
Selector:                 app=nginx
Type:                     ClusterIP
IP Family Policy:         SingleStack
IP Families:              IPv4
IP:                       10.96.0.12
IPs:                      10.96.0.12
Port:                     <unset>  80/TCP
TargetPort:               80/TCP
Endpoints:                10.244.1.2:80
Session Affinity:         None
Internal Traffic Policy:  Cluster
Events:                   <none>
--- stderr

$ kubectl expose deployment nginx --port=80 --name=nginx-svc
--- exit 1 (CONFLICT)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (AlreadyExists): services "nginx-svc" already exists

$ kubectl expose deploy nginx --type=NodePort --target-port=80 --name=nginx-np
--- exit 0
--- stdout
service/nginx-np exposed
--- stderr

$ kubectl get svc nginx-np
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME       TYPE       CLUSTER-IP   EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)        AGE
nginx-np   NodePort   10.96.0.13   <none>        80:32490/TCP   0s
--- stderr

$ kubectl expose pod typo
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: couldn't find port via --port flag or introspection
See 'kubectl expose -h' for help and examples

$ kubectl expose pod typo --port=8080
--- exit 0
--- stdout
service/typo exposed
--- stderr

$ kubectl expose svc web --name=web-copy --port=8080 --target-port=http
--- exit 0
--- stdout
service/web-copy exposed
--- stderr

$ kubectl expose ns default
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: cannot expose a Namespace

$ kubectl expose deploy nope --port=80
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error from server (NotFound): deployments.apps "nope" not found

$ kubectl expose deploy nginx --port=80 --name=lb --type=LoadBalancer --dry-run=client -o yaml
--- exit 0
--- stdout
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: nginx
  name: lb
  namespace: default
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 80
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 80
  selector:
    app: nginx
  type: LoadBalancer
status: {}
--- stderr

$ kubectl expose deploy nginx --port=80 --name=lb --type=LoadBalancer
--- exit 0
--- stdout
service/lb exposed
--- stderr

$ kubectl get svc lb
--- exit 0
--- stdout
NAME   TYPE           CLUSTER-IP   EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)        AGE
lb     LoadBalancer   10.96.0.16   <pending>     80:30088/TCP   0s
--- stderr
